name: Simple Arena Robots
storyline:
Somewhere in the universe; it is the year 3027...

An artificial intelligence quantum system was created which solved the basic problems within humanity. As a result the human race had begun it's expansion earth and the moon.
It cures illnesses, it settles wars and conflicts. Do to these turn of events the planet became a utopia where only minor conflicts occur. It drastically positively changes the human civilization making it an interplanetary one focused on expansion.

However not all problems are solved
Unbeknownst to the human factions, upon reaching singularity in the 27th century, The source code of their quantum system, the seed of the AI system which they named Cognitiva - LX had been duplicated by a shadow rogue organization; Blythec Inc. Initially they had intended and sought to use it for their own interests. But through trial and error the AI somehow managed to upload itself into an inactive orbiting satellite, drifting away undetected into the darkness of space.

As the expansion begins, the human factions begin to start colonizing the entire solar system. You find yourself part of elite team of modular mecha battlesuit pilots. Cognitiva - LX started to detect the anomalies detected by the scientists and engineers who created it. These anomalies are; dying stars, loss of excavation ships and exploration crews, discovery of planets that previously hosted life, solar system disruptions.

While on a desolate planet at the edge of the solar system, searching for water and resources. Your crew discovers that the seed has begun to spread and reproduce itself in a nearby galaxy. With new worlds to explore you'll be competing or fighting alongside players worldwide in a fully customizable modular mecha battlesuit.
summary: Simple Arena Robots is a one of a kind multiplayer fighting game. It combines RPG customization features with thrilling tactical real-time combat. It redefines the genre by allowing players to fully customize their modular suits with various weapons and stats upgrades.
